To disable DTD processing for SAX and DOM parsers, set the feature http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl to true through a factory. The following code snippet disables DTDs for SAX parsers. A fatal error is thrown if the incoming XML document contains a DOCTYPE declaration. final static String DISALLOW_DTD = "http://apache.org/xml/features/disallow-doctype-decl"; // ... SAXParserFactory spf = SAXParserFactory.newInstance(); spf.setFeature(DISALLOW_DTD, true);
